notes: Second-pass candidates compare naive fixed32 storage, pointer storage with the same calculation-local reuse, and fixed32 storage with calculation-local reuse. The combined pool fields are feeGrowthGlobal0X128, feeGrowthGlobal1X128, liquidity, and Slot0.sqrtPriceX96. Existing Remaining pool fixtures already cover creation, wide/narrow mints, no-cross repeats at 1/10/100/1000, exact-out controls, crossing swaps, fee collection, and full removal; no fixture edits were required. Public getters, setters, constructors, Clone, Slot0 snapshots, DrySwap isolation, callbacks, and overflow behavior remain represented by the existing suite plus the combined getter-detachment test.

variants.mechanism: Literal combined4 control: the two global fee accumulators, active liquidity, and Slot0 sqrtPriceX96 use fixed-width 32-byte big-endian strings through the shared codec; calculation reuse, ownership, and AMM algorithms otherwise remain unchanged. Original #49 codec retained; v1 algorithms restored exactly to baseline.

Combined4 fixed32 storage plus calculation-local reuse: swap-start fee snapshots and active liquidity are reused through the current calculation, unchanged fee sides are not decoded/re-encoded, mint/burn reuses the pre-update liquidity, and codec conversion avoids intermediate byte slices. SwapCache constructor requires fee snapshots for every caller; no test-only fallback reads.

Pointer-reuse control: pointer storage is retained while the same swap-start snapshots, pre-update liquidity reuse, clone elimination, and unchanged fee-side application separate representation effects from algorithm effects; public uint getters remain detached. SwapCache constructor requires fee snapshots for every caller; no test-only fallback reads.
External combined Uint-value storage with detached pointer adapters and caller clone cleanup; no local edits or repeated owner-reported package tests.
variants.external_unit_proof: User/owner reports full pool and pool/v1 tests passed on bac78a9; not rerun here.

comparison_limit: Pool is a combined four-field candidate and governance a combined two-field candidate. These are implementation comparisons, not independently attributable per-field deltas. The external value implementations have detached pointer adapters and their own clone cleanup; they are not an identical pure-format ablation of the pointer-reuse control.
